tasks.label: PlatformIO: SSH Monitor - Pure CLI
args: command -v pio >/dev/null 2>&1 && pio run --target sshmonitor || platformio run --target sshmonitor

tasks.label: PlatformIO: Upload and Monitor (SSH) - Pure CLI
args: command -v pio >/dev/null 2>&1 && pio run --target upload --target sshmonitor || platformio run --target upload --target sshmonitor

tasks.label: PlatformIO: SSH Monitor - Specific Environment
args: command -v pio >/dev/null 2>&1 && pio run --target sshmonitor --environment raspberrypi_5 || platformio run --target sshmonitor --environment raspberrypi_5

tasks.label: PlatformIO: Upload and Monitor (SSH) - Specific Environment
args: command -v pio >/dev/null 2>&1 && pio run --target upload --target sshmonitor --environment raspberrypi_5 || platformio run --target upload --target sshmonitor --environment raspberrypi_5
